name: Carbon
note: Experimental Google-led successor language for large C++ codebases
typeSystem: Static and C++-inspired, with a redesigned generics model. Carbon is developing a rigorous memory-safe mode, but that design and implementation remain experimental and are not yet a production-ready language guarantee.
runtime: The experimental toolchain lowers Carbon through semantic IR and LLVM IR to native object code; the language and toolchain are not yet production-ready.

runtimes.name: Native (LLVM, experimental toolchain)
runtimes.role: Experimental compiler targeting native code through LLVM while C++ interoperability is still being implemented.

compilers.name: carbon (experimental)
compilers.role: Google-led open-source experimental compiler and toolchain, not yet production-ready.

concurrencyModel: Not yet finalised; Carbon remains an experimental, evolving language without a stable concurrency model as of its public design documents.
